chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) before his death
ai.seo_question: What is the content of Imam Ali's last will before his death?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the first of Imam Ali’s two final wills, a pivotal document in Shia historiography that transitions leadership from the Caliphate era to the Imamate of Hasan ibn Ali. It serves as a comprehensive testament outlining political advice, spiritual guidance, and social ethics, reflecting the culmination of his forty-year leadership and his strategic preparation for the succession crisis following his martyrdom.
